disclaimer: Evidence confirms browser DOM, rendering, and accessibility node characteristics; makes NO screen reader audio or assistive technology conformance claim.

groups.playwright: Playwright Test automation and runner mechanics
groups.accessibility: Web accessibility profile DOM, ARIA snapshot, focus, and semantics verification
groups.svg: SVG integration, same-origin external use reference, and security route boundary enforcement
groups.browser_runtime: Browser runtime DOM, script execution, networking, storage, and isolation semantics

scenarios.title: Strictness Paired Positive
scenarios.description: Unique locator resolves and clicks successfully; duplicate selector triggers narrow strict mode violation rejection

scenarios.title: Delayed Actionability
scenarios.description: Locator auto-waits for delayed element enablement; permanently disabled element exceeds timeout with actionability failure

scenarios.title: Web-First Assertions
scenarios.description: Auto-retrying expect toHaveText succeeds on delayed text change; impossible text expectation rejects narrowly

scenarios.title: Contexts State Isolation
scenarios.description: Cookies and localStorage created in context A do not leak into concurrently active context B

scenarios.title: Timeout and Cancellation
scenarios.description: Explicit timeout fails with timeout exceeded message; AbortController.signal aborts locator click with AbortError cancellation

scenarios.title: Local Routing Blocked Untrusted
scenarios.description: Ephemeral loopback origin requests pass through; untrusted external network requests are aborted by client route policy

scenarios.title: Popup Frame and Navigation
scenarios.description: Navigation lifecycle state, iframe child frame content access, and popup window lifecycle are verified

scenarios.title: Screenshot and Trace Policy
scenarios.description: Tracing start/stop produces valid trace zip and screenshot capture saves non-empty png inside scratch artifacts directory

scenarios.title: Deterministic Visual Compare
scenarios.description: Same-run baseline screenshot matches identical re-render; controlled visual negative produces byte-level buffer difference

scenarios.title: Playwright Test Retention and Interruption
scenarios.description: Supervised Playwright Test execution verifies passing run artifact absence, controlled failure retention, and actual SIGINT interruption exit 130 with process cleanup

scenarios.title: Native Button Link and Form Naming
scenarios.description: Accessible name computation succeeds for native button, link with aria-label, and labeled input

scenarios.title: Intentional Name Failure Narrowly Asserted
scenarios.description: Empty button has empty accessible name; asserting unexpected accessible name fails with narrow expect rejection

scenarios.title: Headings Landmarks
scenarios.description: Hierarchical heading levels h1, h2, h3 and landmark roles banner, navigation, main are queryable by accessible role

scenarios.title: Focus Order and Visible Focus Difference
scenarios.description: Tab key navigation traverses elements in order; rendered screenshot of focused element differs from blurred state proving visible focus ring

scenarios.title: Interactive Keyboard Focusable SVG
scenarios.description: SVG with role=button, tabindex=0, and accessible name receives keyboard focus and responds to Enter and Space keys

scenarios.title: Meaningful vs Decorative SVG
scenarios.description: Meaningful SVG has role=img and title/aria-label; decorative SVG has aria-hidden=true and empty accessible name

scenarios.title: Complex Information Alternative
scenarios.description: Chart labels and table values agree; removing the structured data alternative leaves the short image name unchanged, demonstrating the distinct information boundary

scenarios.title: Hidden Inert Disabled
scenarios.description: Hidden elements are not visible; disabled elements are disabled; inert containers reject pointer and keyboard interaction

scenarios.title: Dynamic Status Live-Region
scenarios.description: Live region with role=status and aria-live=polite updates dynamic text in DOM/accessibility tree; no AT audio claim made

scenarios.title: ARIA Snapshot
scenarios.description: Hierarchical ARIA snapshot is generated and matches expected structural YAML representation

scenarios.title: Forms Validation Table Motion
scenarios.description: HTML5 form constraint validation checkValidity, accessible table headers, and prefers-reduced-motion media query emulation verified

scenarios.title: Permitted Same-Origin External SVG Use Reference
scenarios.description: Browser requests external SVG sprite, renders visible graphic on target locator, and produces screenshot difference on same locator when reference is missing

scenarios.title: Blocked Origin Resource Negative
scenarios.description: Foreign-origin SVG use remains visibly empty under browser/resource policy; a separate fetch probe proves route refusal without claiming that use reached routing

scenarios.title: Blocked Path Resource Negative
scenarios.description: Attempt to reference unauthorized path outside fixtures is blocked by server/route policy and results in visible absence; raw traversal returns 403 Forbidden

scenarios.title: Document Lifecycle and ReadyState
scenarios.description: Document advances through readystate transitions (loading, interactive, complete), fires DOMContentLoaded, load, and pageshow events in deterministic order, and exposes active visibilityState

scenarios.title: Parser and Dynamic DOM with MutationObserver Cleanup
scenarios.description: Parser-inserted scripts and dynamically appended scripts execute in sequence; MutationObserver captures child and attribute records before clean disconnection without leaks

scenarios.title: Event Capture, Bubble, Cancellation, Options, and Removal
scenarios.description: DOM event dispatch traverses capture, target, and bubble phases; stopPropagation halts traversal, preventDefault records defaultPrevented, once option fires once, and removeEventListener successfully unbinds

scenarios.title: Microtask, Task, rAF, and Timer Cleanup
scenarios.description: Microtasks queue and drain before next task; requestAnimationFrame executes before next paint frame; clearTimeout and cancelAnimationFrame successfully cancel scheduled work

scenarios.title: URL Parsing and Different-Port Origin Distinction
scenarios.description: URL API accurately parses protocol, host, port, path, search, and hash components; differing loopback ports establish distinct origins despite shared 127.0.0.1 host; relative base resolution has a same-origin positive control

scenarios.title: Real Local CORS Allow, Deny, Preflight, and Opaque
scenarios.description: Real loopback Server 2 enforces CORS policies: allowed origin succeeds with data; denied origin throws fetch error; preflight OPTIONS succeeds or refuses; no-cors mode returns opaque response; restrictive meta-CSP contains this un-intercepted lane and refuses a fifth valid local endpoint without a server request

scenarios.title: Fetch Abort, Redirect, and Synthetic Credentials
scenarios.description: An already-aborted default-reason signal refuses Fetch with AbortError; a 302 redirect reaches its target; host-scoped synthetic cookies are included or omitted as selected and observed by the server. In-flight cancellation is outside this predicate.

scenarios.title: localStorage and sessionStorage Context Boundaries
scenarios.description: localStorage persists across page reloads and emits storage events in peer contexts; sessionStorage is scoped to the browsing context and isolated from independent contexts

scenarios.title: History API and Location Navigation
scenarios.description: history.pushState and replaceState update URL path and state without full reload; popstate event fires on history.back() restoring state; hash change fires hashchange event

scenarios.title: Custom Elements, Shadow DOM, and Slot Projection
scenarios.description: Autonomous custom element executes connectedCallback and observed attribute callbacks; shadow root encapsulates styles and DOM tree; slots distribute light DOM content

scenarios.title: Computed Style and Geometry Resolution
scenarios.description: getComputedStyle resolves cascade and custom property values; getBoundingClientRect yields accurate pixel layout metrics; scroll geometry reflects overflowing content

scenarios.title: Web Worker Messaging and Termination
scenarios.description: Dedicated Web Worker instantiates from real server allowlist, performs bidirectional postMessage exchange, and terminates cleanly upon worker.terminate()

scenarios.title: Module and Resource URL Success and Refusal
scenarios.description: Module and submodule URLs load from the local allowlist; a missing same-origin module URL reaches the server, returns 404 and is refused by the browser. This is not cross-origin module/CORS qualification.

scenarios.title: Blob URL Creation, Fetch, and Revocation
scenarios.description: URL.createObjectURL generates functional blob URL readable via fetch; URL.revokeObjectURL revokes the URL making subsequent access fail with network error
